title: a shift on the right of < after a capitalised binding binds tighter than the comparison
purpose: Accept the construct and observe its result.

provenance.origin: authored for #1032 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: grammar: shift binds tighter than comparison, and a binding of any case compares with < (#1004): 1<(8>>2)=1<2 true; 1<(8>>>3)=1<1 false; 1<(16>>4)=1<1 false; (16>>2)>1=4>1 true.
